name: European Seabass (Spigola / Branzino / Loup de mer)
tactics: Target white-water surf zones and harbor mouths during Mistral (NW) winds. Use 120mm minnow plugs, live prawns, or soft plastic paddle tails on slow retrieves.
rigging: 20lb Braid + 25lb Fluorocarbon Leader | #1/0 Live Bait Hook | Carolina Running Sinker Rig

name: Gilthead Seabream (Orata / Dorade)
tactics: Target Posidonia seagrass margins and shellfish beds. Skittish bottom feeder with crushing jaws. Best fished on Full Moon nights with live shore crabs, bibi worms, or fresh mussels.
rigging: 15lb Mono + 20lb Clear Leader | #2 Chinu Hook | Inline Sliding Sinker Rig

name: Greater Amberjack (Ricciola)
tactics: High-speed pack hunter on seamounts and offshore wrecks. Deep vertical metal jigging (150g–250g) or live squid trolling during Solunar Moon Overhead periods.
rigging: 65lb Braid + 80lb Fluorocarbon Leader (FG Knot) | #7/0 Live Squid Hook | Deep Vertical Jigging / Trolling Rig

name: Common Dentex (Dentice)
tactics: The 'King of the Mediterranean Reef'. Solitary apex hunter on steep rocky pinnacles. Slow-troll live squid or octopus near bottom structure.
rigging: 50lb Braid + 60lb Hard Leader | Double #5/0 Octopus Hooks | Live Squid Slow-Troll Rig

name: Atlantic Bluefin Tuna (Tonno Rosso)
tactics: Massive pelagic predator. Drift chumming ('Drifting') with sardines or surface popping into boiling feeding frenzies ('Mangianze').
rigging: 80lb-100lb Braid + 100lb Leader | #8/0 Circle Hook | Sardine Drifting / Popper Heavy Rig

name: Mahi-Mahi / Dolphinfish (Lampuga / Cannizzo)
tactics: Targets floating FADs ('Cannizzi') and debris. Light tackle trolling with feathers, small skirts, or live silversides.
rigging: 30lb Braid + 40lb Leader | #3/0 Trolling Hook | Feather Skirt Trolling Rig

name: Bluefish (Serra / Anchoa)
tactics: Razor-sharp teeth predator in coastal bays and river mouths. Use topwater needlefish plugs, poppers, or wire-leader live bait rigs.
rigging: 30lb Braid + 30lb Single Strand Wire Leader | #2/0 Treble Hook | Topwater Needlefish Plug Rig

name: Leerfish / Garrick (Leccia Amia)
tactics: Large coastal predator lurking in river estuaries and beach breakers. Fast topwater popping or live mullet trolling.
rigging: 40lb Braid + 50lb Leader | #4/0 Live Mullet Hook | Live Bait Trolling Rig

name: White Seabream (Sarago Maggiore)
tactics: Heavy surf and rocky ledges. Light rock fishing (LRF) or bottom float fishing with sea worms and shrimp.
rigging: 10lb Braid + 12lb Fluorocarbon Leader | #4 Worm Hook | LRF Micro Sinker Rig

name: European Squid (Calamaro)
tactics: Winter Night Peak! Lighted harbor piers or slow boat drift using Egi squid jigs (size 2.5–3.5).
rigging: 12lb Braid + 16lb Fluorocarbon Leader | Size 3.0 Egi Jig | Slow Driftegi Rig
